summary: Our project, Planet X and SPHEREx, is an interactive web-based platform designed to make astronomy easy and interesting for everyone. It provides information about the Planet X hypothesis and NASA's SPHEREx space telescope mission. The website uses HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to create a simple, user-friendly interface with easy navigation. Users can explore space science topics and understand important astronomical concepts through organized information. This project aims to improve space science awareness and encourage students to learn more about the universe. In the future, we plan to add interactive 3D visualizations and live NASA data to enhance the learning experience.
details: Our project, Planet X and SPHEREx, is a web-based interactive astronomy platform designed to make space science easy to understand for students and beginners. The website provides information about the Planet X hypothesis and NASA's SPHEREx space telescope mission. Users can explore different sections through simple navigation and learn about important astronomical concepts. The website was developed using HTML for structure, CSS for styling, and JavaScript for interactive features. It presents organized information in a user-friendly format. The main aim is to increase interest in astronomy and improve awareness of space science. This project helps students understand space-related topics and encourages them to explore the universe. Future improvements include interactive 3D visualizations and integration of live NASA data.
